gaps.explanation: p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints General Fund, Street Fund, Sales Tax Fund, Park Fund and Other Governmental Funds columns. Only Other Governmental Funds has a schedule (p10 combining schedule, revenues 56,951 in detail: Keno 54,531 + 637, Reading Center 1,783). The budgetary schedule (p9) itemizes no revenues. Missing columns: General Fund total revenues 2,046,641 (1,596,962 + 179,486 + 11,716 + 132,951 + 40,055 + 79,138 + 6,333), Street Fund 553,144 (394,413 + 149,276 + 9,360 + 95), Sales Tax Fund 589,549 (552,717 + 1,498 + 35,334), Park Fund 77,952 (17,290 + 60,622 + 40). 2,046,641 + 553,144 + 589,549 + 77,952 = 3,267,286 = gap. 56,951 + 3,267,286 = 3,324,237 = printed Total revenues.

gaps.explanation: Detail expenditures are the p9 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Fund Types, Actual Amounts (Budgetary Basis): General government 1,246,353 + Police 145,729 + Public works - Streets 731,544 + Culture and recreation 224,322 = total governmental charges to appropriations 2,347,948 (p9). The p4 statement (GAAP, modified accrual) prints total expenditures 2,428,269. Function by function: Police 145,729 = Law Enforcement public safety 145,729; Streets 731,544 = Street Fund total expenditures 731,544; Culture and recreation 224,322 = Park Fund 215,501 + Other Governmental 8,821; General government 1,246,353 (budgetary) vs General Fund 1,310,093 + Sales Tax Fund 16,581 = 1,326,674 on p4 (incl. debt service 115,000 and General Fund capital outlay 184,102). 1,326,674 - 1,246,353 = 80,321 = gap. The two printed totals differ by basis (budgetary vs GAAP); no line is missing or duplicated. No fix.

p5 (statement continued) Interfund transfers in: General 211,531, Street 178,495, Sales Tax 142,926, Park 161,297, Other Governmental 145,729, Total 839,978. Detail has only the p10 Law Enforcement transfer in 145,729. 211,531 + 178,495 + 142,926 + 161,297 = 694,249 = gap; 145,729 + 694,249 = 839,978.

gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position - Business-Type Activities prints Water, Electric and Sewer columns; detail has no business-type revenue at all (the p9 budget schedule lists only expenditures). Water: User fees and charges 788,231 + Building and development fees 37,960 + Miscellaneous 37,100 + Interest income 6,316 = 869,607. Electric: 216,223 + 17,290 + 4,702 = 238,215. Sewer: 915,265 + 13,000 + 36,924 = 965,189. 869,607 + 238,215 + 965,189 = 2,073,011 = statement total (operating revenues 2,025,069 + interest income 47,942). Interfund transfers in/out on p7 are not revenue and are not added (no business-type transfer gap row).

gaps.explanation: Detail business-type spending is the p9 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Fund Types, Actual Amounts (Budgetary Basis): Water 833,009 + Electric utility 464,707 + Sewer 7,430,560 = total business-type charges to appropriations 8,728,276 (p9). It is a cash/budgetary outflow total (includes capital purchases and debt principal; no depreciation). The p7 statement (GAAP) prints total operating expenses 1,399,112 (incl. depreciation and amortization 716,700) + interest expense 297,014 = 1,696,126 (= Statement of Activities business-type expenses p2). Per fund: Water 462,935 + 105,741 = 568,676 vs 833,009; Electric 417,330 + 22,811 = 440,141 vs 464,707; Sewer 518,847 + 168,462 = 687,309 vs 7,430,560. The two printed totals differ by basis (8,728,276 - 1,696,126 = 7,032,150); no line is missing or duplicated. No fix.
